Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about Brightware's ingestion pipeline and latency targets for real-time summarization. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: real-time summarization for customer support transcripts (avg seq length ~ 1.2k tokens).
- Key constraints: 200ms P95 for short requests (<256 tokens); need per-tenant isolation for compliance.
- Success metric: reduce agent handle time by 20% while keeping hallucination <2% on test prompts.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Short technical deep-dive with Rishi to review KV cache and batching strategy — 30 minutes.
2) 2-week pilot on a dedicated instance (we can scope data access needs & provide test scripts).
3) Align on security checklist (SOC 2 / VPC options) and timeline for procurement.

I've attached a short overview of Redwood's production architecture and a draft scope for the pilot. Suggested times for the deep-dive: Wed 8/5 10:00-10:30am PT or Thu 8/6 2:00-2:30pm PT — let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.
